description: Major powers compete while preserving institutional cooperation and crisis communication.
States organize into security technology trade finance and information blocs.
Regional crises multiply while global institutions weaken.
AI cyber semiconductors satellites data and platforms become central fields of strategic competition.
Climate shocks food pressure water scarcity displacement and infrastructure risk intensify geopolitical stress.
Regions build stronger energy food infrastructure health and security systems.
Global and regional institutions adapt through representation accountability and enforcement reform.
Rules institutions communication and restraint mechanisms fail across geopolitical domains.
